jobs.description: University of Michigan Taubman College seeks a PhD applicant for an NSF-funded program on intelligent robotic 3D concrete printing under Professor Mania Aghaei Meibodi. The project aims to make large-scale robotic 3D printing of complex, materially efficient building elements such as topology-optimized beams and slabs more reliable and less wasteful, and applicants should hold a master's degree (or bachelor's with strong research experience) in Architecture, Civil/Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Construction Engineering or a related field.
jobs.summary: University of Michigan Taubman College seeks a PhD applicant for an NSF-funded program on intelligent robotic 3D concrete printing under Professor Mania Aghaei Meibodi, at the intersection of computational design, robotics, data science, AI and advanced manufacturing. The funded position includes a graduate student research assistantship stipend, tuition and health insurance, worth more than $400,000 in overall support.
jobs.title: NSF-Funded Ph.D. Opportunity in Intelligent Robotic 3D Concrete Printing

jobs.description: University of Toronto Department of Civil & Mineral Engineering (SuStrucSy group, Prof. Aryan Rezaei Rad) invites applications for a fully-funded PhD in Digital Fabrication and Timber Engineering and Construction, at the intersection of robotic fabrication, structural engineering and computational mechanics. The student will design, fabricate and test 1:1 scale mass timber systems such as interlocking connections and wall-floor systems, using a KUKA KR 210 R3100 robotic arm, multi-scale experimental testing and ABAQUS finite element simulations.
jobs.summary: University of Toronto Department of Civil & Mineral Engineering (SuStrucSy group, Prof. Aryan Rezaei Rad) invites applications for a fully-funded PhD in Digital Fabrication and Timber Engineering and Construction, designing, fabricating and testing 1:1 scale mass timber load-carrying systems with a 6-axis robotic arm and finite element modelling. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until filled, with a competitive funding package for the duration of the PhD.
jobs.title: Fully-Funded PhD Position: Digital Fabrication and Mass Timber Engineering

jobs.description: University of Toronto Department of Civil & Mineral Engineering (SuStrucSy group, Prof. Aryan Rezaei Rad) invites applications for a fully-funded PhD in Computational Design, Structural Optimization, and Digital Fabrication of Timber Structures. The student will develop an integrated digital workflow bridging computational structural engineering, algorithmic-aided design and timber construction using COMPAS, CadWork, Rhino and OpenSees, with CSA O86-24 design checks validated on 1:1 scale industrial case studies.
jobs.summary: University of Toronto Department of Civil & Mineral Engineering (SuStrucSy group, Prof. Aryan Rezaei Rad) invites applications for a fully-funded PhD in Computational Design, Structural Optimization, and Digital Fabrication of Timber Structures, developing an integrated CAD–CAE–CAM workflow for modular timber construction. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until filled, with a competitive funding package.
jobs.title: Fully-Funded PhD Position: Digital Timber – Integrated CAD–CAE–CAM for Modular Construction

jobs.description: UT Austin INSPIRE Lab (Dr. Zhaomiao Guo) is recruiting one fully funded PhD student for Fall 2027. Research will center on AI, optimization, and decision intelligence for infrastructure systems, including infrastructure resilience, network optimization, data analytics and simulation, and strong quantitative and programming backgrounds are preferred.
jobs.summary: UT Austin INSPIRE Lab (Dr. Zhaomiao Guo, Civil, Architectural and Environmental Engineering) is recruiting one fully funded PhD student for Fall 2027 to research AI, optimization and decision intelligence for infrastructure systems. Applicants apply through the Cockrell School of Engineering centralized review process and also email their CV to Dr. Guo.
jobs.title: PhD Position — Fully Funded

jobs.description: University of Waterloo PhD in Civil Engineering lists an opening for a fully-funded PhD student on a Generation Risk Assessment project developing system reliability coupled with a Bayesian updating framework to optimize the performance of power generation systems and facilitate dynamic updating of risk and reliability estimates as new inspection and surveillance data become available. Admission requires a master's degree with an 80% average and evidence of ability to pursue independent research.
jobs.summary: University of Waterloo PhD in Civil Engineering lists an opening for a fully-funded PhD student on a Generation Risk Assessment project developing system reliability coupled with a Bayesian updating framework to optimize power generation system performance as new inspection and surveillance data arrive.
jobs.title: Bayesian System Reliability Analysis of Engineering Systems

jobs.description: McGill University Frigon Lab offers a funded MSc or PhD position starting September 2027 on an NSERC Alliance Advantage project investigating greenhouse gas emissions from wastewater treatment plants. The project combines activated sludge process modelling, greenhouse gas emissions prediction (CH4 and N2O), metagenomics and microbial ecology, and bioinformatics, and the student will also join the NSERC CREATE program in Genomics for Engineering, Environmental Monitoring and Agriculture (GEEMA).
jobs.summary: McGill University Frigon Lab offers a funded MSc or PhD position starting September 2027 (no later than Fall 2027) on an NSERC Alliance Advantage project investigating greenhouse gas emissions from wastewater treatment plants, combining activated sludge modelling, methane and nitrous oxide prediction, metagenomics and bioinformatics. Academic application to the department is due January 1, 2027.
jobs.title: Graduate Student Position (PhD or MSc) – Wastewater Process Modeling, Genomics and Bioinformatics

jobs.description: Fully funded 3.5-year PhD studentship from 1 October 2027 in the Structural Materials Group, Department of Materials Science and Metallurgy, University of Cambridge, on alloy development for hydrogen fuelled aircraft propulsion. The project will investigate hydrogen embrittlement mechanisms in nickel-based superalloys and help guide design of hydrogen-resistant superalloys, in collaboration with Rolls-Royce plc.
jobs.summary: Fully funded 3.5-year PhD studentship in the Structural Materials Group, Department of Materials Science and Metallurgy, University of Cambridge, on hydrogen embrittlement in superalloys for hydrogen-powered gas turbines, funded by EPSRC and Rolls-Royce.
jobs.title: PhD Studentship: Alloy development for hydrogen fuelled aircraft propulsion

jobs.description: Fully funded 3.5-year PhD studentship from 1 October 2027 in the Structural Materials Group, Department of Materials Science and Metallurgy, University of Cambridge, on deformation mechanisms across a chemically graded bond zone. The project will establish the science governing transient liquid phase bond integrity in nickel-based superalloys for future aero-engines, in collaboration with Rolls-Royce plc.
jobs.summary: Fully funded 3.5-year PhD studentship in the Structural Materials Group, Department of Materials Science and Metallurgy, University of Cambridge, on deformation mechanisms in transient liquid phase bonded nickel-based superalloys, funded by EPSRC and Rolls-Royce.
jobs.title: PhD Studentship: Deformation mechanisms across a chemically graded bond zone

jobs.description: Fully funded 1+3 MRes+PhD studentships in the EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Future Infrastructure and Built Environment: Unlocking Net Zero (FIBE3 CDT), in the Department of Engineering, University of Cambridge, in collaboration with industry, covering current and disruptive technologies, circularity and whole-life approach, AI-driven digitalisation and data, and risk-based systems thinking.
jobs.summary: Fully funded 1+3 MRes+PhD studentships in the EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Future Infrastructure and Built Environment: Unlocking Net Zero, in the Department of Engineering, University of Cambridge.
jobs.title: EPSRC FIBE3 CDT MRes+PhD in Future Infrastructure and Built Environment: Unlocking Net Zero

jobs.description: Call for 23 predoctoral contracts for doctoral training at Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya, managed by UPC on mandate from the State Research Agency and co-financed by the European Social Fund Plus. Contracts are for up to 4 years, at €25,457 gross per year, plus €7,000 for research stays and PhD tuition fees, for candidates enrolled or admitted full-time in a UPC PhD programme linked to the listed projects.
jobs.summary: Call for 23 predoctoral contracts for doctoral training at Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya, associated with Knowledge Generation Projects 2025, including civil and environmental engineering projects, for up to 4 years at €25,457 gross per year.
jobs.title: Doctoral Training Grants 2026

jobs.description: Second edition of the FPU-UPC 2026 call offering predoctoral grants for full-time research training leading to a PhD degree at Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya, covering remaining positions across UPC departments, institutes and UNESCO chairs. Grants run for up to 4 years, with up to 60 teaching hours per year, and require admission to a UPC doctoral programme and a UPC thesis supervisor.
jobs.summary: Second edition of the FPU-UPC 2026 call offering predoctoral grants for full-time research training leading to a PhD at Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya, for up to 4 years at €20,364.88 gross per year in years 1-2 and €25,456.20 in years 3-4.
jobs.title: FPU UPC 2026 - 2nd ed.

jobs.description: Fully funded PhD opportunity in the EPSRC Doctoral Landscape Award at the University of Sheffield, supervised by Dr Linwei He and Prof Sam Rigby. The project will develop AI-enabled optimisation methods for sustainable and resilient building design, contributing to Peregrine, a structural layout optimisation tool, in collaboration with LimitState Ltd. The award funds full tuition fees and a maintenance stipend at the UKRI rate, currently £21,805 per annum, plus an industry-funded stipend enhancement.
jobs.summary: Fully funded EPSRC Doctoral Landscape Award PhD in the School of Mechanical, Aerospace and Civil Engineering, University of Sheffield, developing AI-enabled optimisation methods for sustainable and resilient building design with LimitState Ltd.
jobs.title: AI-Enabled Optimisation for the Next Generation of Sustainable and Resilient Building Design (in collaboration with LimitState Ltd.) (C3.5-MAC-He)

jobs.description: Fully funded PhD studentship investigating how artificial intelligence can understand, model and interact with the physical world, with a focus on infrastructure and construction. The student is based at CIRI at the University of Galway with joint supervision from CIRI and the University of Cambridge, including a visiting period of at least six months at Cambridge. Research directions include subsurface 3D reconstruction using physics-supervised learning and multimodal sensing, underground digital twins, physics-informed machine learning for particle contact, Physical AI for construction robotics, and scientific machine learning for infrastructure, particularly soil mechanics. Applications are by email (CV and one-page research proposal) to Professor Brian Sheil, subject line SoE_studentship_26. The studentship is funded by the School of Engineering at the University of Galway.
jobs.summary: Fully funded PhD studentship funded by the School of Engineering at the University of Galway, jointly supervised at CIRI (Ward & Burke Centre for Infrastructure Research & Innovation) in Galway and the University of Cambridge, investigating how AI can understand, model and interact with the physical world, with a focus on infrastructure and construction.
jobs.title: Fully funded PhD studentship in Physical AI for the Built World

jobs.description: PhD scholarship in structural health monitoring, supervised by Professor Alex Ng in the School of Civil Engineering and Construction Management at Adelaide University. The project develops non-contact ultrasonic techniques for damage detection in structures with challenging surface conditions, as part of research into structural health monitoring and nondestructive evaluation for infrastructure integrity assessment. Applications are open and accepted until the position is filled. The successful applicant is awarded a full scholarship covering tuition fees and a living allowance, and should contact Professor Ng directly by email.
jobs.summary: Fully funded PhD scholarship in structural health monitoring in the School of Civil Engineering and Construction Management at Adelaide University, developing non-contact ultrasonic techniques for damage detection in structures with challenging surface conditions.
jobs.title: PhD Scholarship 1: Non-contact Ultrasonic Techniques for Damage Detection in Structures with Challenging Surface Conditions

jobs.description: PhD scholarship in structural health monitoring, supervised by Professor Alex Ng in the School of Civil Engineering and Construction Management at Adelaide University. The project develops an advanced non-contact ultrasonic inspection system for structural safety inspection, as part of research into structural health monitoring and nondestructive evaluation for infrastructure integrity assessment. Applications are open and accepted until the position is filled. The successful applicant is awarded a full scholarship covering tuition fees and a living allowance, and should contact Professor Ng directly by email.
jobs.summary: Fully funded PhD scholarship in structural health monitoring in the School of Civil Engineering and Construction Management at Adelaide University, developing an advanced non-contact ultrasonic inspection system for structural safety inspection.
jobs.title: PhD Scholarship 2: Development of an Advanced Non-contact Ultrasonic Inspection System for Structural Safety Inspection

jobs.description: Fully funded PhD scholarship (PhD 1 of two) under the ARC Future Fellowship 'Digital twins for resilient underground infrastructure' at Monash University, supervised by Associate Professor Qianbing Zhang. The project focuses on multi-hazard modelling for resilient infrastructure, developing coupled models of tunnelling, earthquakes and water leakage validated against the Monash campus sensor network. The scholarship offers an RTP stipend of AUD 41,100 per annum, a tuition fee scholarship for international candidates, access to supercomputing and sensor networks, and industry collaboration. Applicants need first-class honours or a research master's in engineering or a related field, with modelling experience and Python programming skills. Applications are by email to the supervisor.
jobs.summary: Fully funded PhD scholarship under an ARC Future Fellowship on digital twins for resilient underground infrastructure at Monash University (Clayton), developing coupled models of tunnelling, earthquakes and water leakage validated against the Monash campus sensor network.
jobs.title: PhD Scholarship: Multi-hazard Modelling for Resilient Infrastructure (Digital Twins for Resilient Underground Infrastructure)

jobs.description: Fully funded PhD scholarship (PhD 2 of two) under the ARC Future Fellowship 'Digital twins for resilient underground infrastructure' at Monash University, supervised by Associate Professor Qianbing Zhang. The project, 'Watching cities breathe from space', combines satellite radar (InSAR), 3D geological models and groundwater records to quantify ground movement from Melbourne to worldwide cities. The scholarship offers an RTP stipend of AUD 41,100 per annum, a tuition fee scholarship for international candidates, access to supercomputing and sensor networks, and industry collaboration. Applicants need first-class honours or a research master's in engineering, geoscience or computer science, with modelling experience and Python programming skills. Applications are by email to the supervisor.
jobs.summary: Fully funded PhD scholarship under an ARC Future Fellowship on digital twins for resilient underground infrastructure at Monash University (Clayton), combining satellite radar (InSAR), 3D geological models and groundwater records to quantify ground movement.
jobs.title: PhD Scholarship: Watching Cities Breathe from Space (Digital Twins for Resilient Underground Infrastructure)

jobs.description: PhD positions at UNSW Sydney in the School of Civil and Environmental Engineering, funded through the Australian Government Cooperative Research Centre Project (CRC-P) 'Smart Tech for Safer Dams: Tackling Erosion with Innovation' (1 Apr 2026 – 31 Mar 2029), in collaboration with Pells Consulting and Sunwater. The three PhD projects cover automated 3D digital models for rock erosion assessment, CFD-informed erosion interpretation and comparative design methods, and coupled computational modelling of spillway erosion, using robotic technologies, UAV and USV surveys, geological interpretation and physical hydraulic modelling. Candidates should have a first-class honours degree in civil, geotechnical or hydraulic engineering or a related field. Applications are by direct contact with Dr Adnan Sufian; the UNSW page states PhD and postdoctoral opportunities are available.
jobs.summary: PhD positions at UNSW Sydney in the School of Civil and Environmental Engineering, developing novel technologies for modelling erosion of dams for climate extremes under the Australian Government CRC-P project 'Smart Tech for Safer Dams', in collaboration with Pells Consulting and Sunwater.
jobs.title: PhD Positions: Smart Tech for Safer Dams — Tackling Erosion with Innovation
